add.name: Add
add.tip: Create a skill with the specified ID and add it to the actor's skill list (if the same skill already exists, skip)

remove.name: Remove
remove.tip: Remove the skill with the specified ID from the actor's skill list

remove-instance.name: Remove Instance
remove-instance.tip: Read a skill from the skill getter and remove it from the actor's skill list

sort-by-order.name: Sort by Filename
sort-by-order.tip: Sort all skills of the actor by filename
